stable_ids: explicit contiguous append-only; never reuse/reorder IDs

scope_rules.global_only: same value in every roster profile; individual/distribution overrides rejected
scope_rules.bot: independent stable logical bot identity; slot0 is human and never driven

value_syntax.range_sampling: deterministic per(seed,stableBotId,ParamId) quantile; exclude spawnEpoch and iteration order
value_syntax.event_variation: explicit jitter/error parameters use behavior RNG, separate from stable range sampling

live_semantics.consumer_effective_revision: next existing TickBots after all active consumers ApplyProfile and acknowledge
live_semantics.precision: real sense/decision/native action cadence, not UI numeric display
live_semantics.lifecycle: keep life/memory; interrupt incompatible actions and release inputs; no respawn resampling

timing_contract: visual evidence and scenario perceive deadlines share stimulus origin; do not add recognition twice; ReactionStart and PrimaryDelay share action-start edge and use max; later Secondary/Micro stages are distinct

parameters.name_zh: 推进步态额外时长波动
parameters.description_zh: 每个稳定步态段增加0到本值的均匀时长；0固定节奏。实际输出按已有Tick离散，静步/跑步实速由原角色、武器、坡面和受击机制决定。
parameters.condition_zh: 已证明可走的普通Roam/Search/Relocate及听声接近导航正在实际输出移动；不覆盖peek、对枪身法、回撤、找掩体或换弹。
parameters.precision_zh: 原生walk布尔输入；方向仍单位化，不缩放轴值、不设置MaxWalkSpeed。按已有Tick保持和重选；需要原生速度/姿态读回才能验证实际效果。
parameters.unsupported_zh: 消费者采用与原角色实际静步/跑步速度是独立证据；未测实速不标为任意速度已生效。
